name: All-Angles
intro: All-Angles Bench 包含 90 个真实多视角场景与 2,132 个三选一问答对，通过计数、属性、相对距离、相对方向、物体操作和相机姿态六类任务评估 MLLM 的跨视角对应与几何一致性，并用配对问题诊断预测不一致。
org: UC Berkeley, HKU, NYU, University of Oxford, UC Davis, TranscEngram, SLAI
build_method: 场景与视角人工筛选, GPT-4o问题起草, 八名标注员全量复核
metric: 准确率, 配对问题不一致率
task_type: 多视角三选一视觉问答
eval_feature: 多视角, 几何一致性, 跨视角对应
build_method_en: Human scene and view selection, GPT-4o question drafting, full review by eight annotators
intro_en: All-Angles Bench contains 2,132 three-option QA pairs over 90 real multi-view scenes. Six tasks—counting, attributes, relative distance, relative direction, object manipulation, and camera pose—test cross-view correspondence and geometric consistency, while paired questions diagnose prediction inconsistency.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.15280 Sections 3-4 and Figure 3: 83 Ego-Exo4D plus seven EgoHumans scenes; manual selection of 90 scenes with at least three useful views and final sets of four to five spatially dispersed 796x448 images; six task categories; GPT-4o drafting with three questions per task/scene except one camera-pose item; all-view use for counting/camera pose and two random views otherwise; full review by eight STEM PhD annotators; three choices with exactly one correct answer; paired rephrasing, orientation swaps, or view changes that preserve correspondence; final human QC; 2,132 QA pairs with 85.3% paired coverage excluding counting; 27-model accuracy and paired inconsistency evaluation; and a stratified 250-question human reference.
